kapak.alt: The probe tube in real-ear measurement

youtube.baslik: How close should the probe tube get to the eardrum? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In real-ear measurement, the probe tube tip should come within about 5 mm of the tympanic membrane (eardrum). If the tip stays too far back, the reflected wave can cancel the incoming wave and a false notch appears at high frequencies.
youtube.kapanis_metni: Follow AIHEAR Audiology Academy for more quick facts.

cumleler: How close should the probe tube get to the eardrum?
The tip should come within about five millimeters of the tympanic membrane.
If it sits too far back, reflected sound can cancel incoming sound.
A false notch then appears at high frequencies.
